description:
Use this when the user wants to see how a clip looks at one moment: "show me the captions", "how does the
        title look", "what did that effect do". Returns a still image of clip_id (from list_clips) at at_seconds
        (seconds into the finished clip, default 1; a photo shows whole), as last rendered with its captions and edits. Right after style_clip, add_to_clip,
        translate_captions or edit_clip, wait for job_status to say done, or the picture is the previous version (the
        answer says so).
        Not for: playing the clip (show_clips), the video file (get_download_link) or changing anything. Free and read
        only.
name: preview_frame
title: Preview a frame
